name: Sakurao Gin Original
owner: SAKURAO Brewery and Distillery Co. Ltd. (formerly Chugoku Jozo, founded 1918)
production: Nine botanicals from Hiroshima Prefecture plus five imported (incl. juniper, coriander)
history: 2018 | Sakurao Gin Original released (March 2018); gold medal at LAISC 2018, described as the first Japanese gin to do so
expressions: Sakurao Gin Limited | 17 botanicals incl. oyster shell and wasabi, 47%
serve_official: G&T with dry or Indian tonic; also neat or in cocktails (importer page)
notes: Japan launch price 2,000 yen before tax (Nomunication 2018). Botanical lists differ slightly between sources (Nomunication omits lemon). Total botanical_count = 9 local + 5 imported per importer.
